newsitem.title: USA: Amerigon names new president. [CORRECTED 15:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Amerigon names new president. [CORRECTED 15:10 GMT]

text.p: Amerigon Inc said Richard Weisbart will join the company as president and chief operating officer effective May 5.

The position of chief operating officer is newly created. Chairman and chief executive Lon Bell previously held the position of president. (Company corrects to make clear that position of chief operating officer is newly created and that Bell previously held position of president.)
Weisbart, who was director of International Programs for the Ford division of Lear Corp, also has been elected to the company's board of directors.

Weisbart, 51, will be responsible to plan and execute the company's business objectives, implement and maintain strong financial systems and help guide and direct management in the development, production and sale of the products and services.
